sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: A 🖼 gallery on the other sites' tables (springsteenlyrics.com, jungleland.it, brucespringsteen.it, Brucebase, discogs.com), as on MusicBrainz: the 🖼 after a table's row count opens a window with every image of the rows already read — by a hover, a click, or an earlier visit (read from this browser, no request). For the others it offers one button that says what it costs ("Load the other 32 (about 35 s)"; on Discogs without a token also what it would cost with one); a run over five minutes asks first, Stop or closing the window ends it, and the rows read stay read. A progress bar, counts and a Recent log show how it goes; a row that failed offers Try again. Type chips (Front, Back, Booklet; Photo, Ticket, News; primary, secondary …) narrow the images, "Compare two" puts two rows side by side, and a click on an image opens the artwork viewer, Shift+← → through the gallery's rows.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: The foreign-image providers gained `peekSaved()`, `spacingS()`, `tokenSpacingS()`, `kept()` and their gallery words; `_fiDpPeek()` is the render sweep's saved-page read, now shared with the gallery; `_fiColIdx()` reads a table's column names once per header row. MusicBrainz: `updateH2Count()` re-anchors one more id prefix (`mb-fgal-btn-`), and `_fgalAfterRender()` beside `_dgMbAfterRender()` returns at once off the foreign hosts.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: springsteenlyrics.com lyrics index: a small 🖼 after each title stands for the song page's pictures (the covers of the albums a song is on, now and then a hand-written sheet). It is dashed until that page has been read, then shows how many there are, or disappears when there are none. Pointing at it shows them (a single picture large), a click opens the artwork viewer (Ctrl-click: the song's page). It follows the setting "Cover column: every image of an item on hover"; songs read before show their count at once, with no request.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase song list: the same 🖼 after each title for the song page's graph and lyric sheets: dashed until read, then the count, gone when the page has none; a card on hover, the viewer on a click. Songs read before show their count at once, with no request.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: The Brucebase song preview (card and window) now shows the song page's images too: the graph and the lyric sheets, which open the artwork viewer from the window. Pages saved before are read again once, because what is kept of a page has changed (the springsteenlyrics.com, jungleland.it and brucespringsteen.it pages too).

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: Brucebase year pages: in the Media column the Photo, Ticket, News and Memorabilia icons are ringed and open what they announce. Pointing at one shows a card with those images from the entry's own page (photos, tickets, passes, newspaper clippings); a click opens the artwork viewer on them, every other kind one ← → away, and Shift+← → go to the previous or next row (Ctrl-click: the page). The page is read on that first hover or click only, one request for that row, kept 30 days. Works for every entry with a page of its own (shows, rehearsals, recordings …), on a year page and on "all years". New setting "Media icons and song glyphs: the page's images on hover" (on by default, the card only).

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: The foreign sites' image click (`_fiClick()`) builds a row when the viewer first shows it, not every row of the table up front, and a row with several triggers (a year row's Media icons) is one stop for Shift+← →. On a 10,348-row year table (four years cloned, Playwright Chromium) a click takes about 0.17 s after the first.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: jungleland.it list: a new Art column. Each row shows a dashed tile until its artwork page has been read, then the front scan and the number of scans. Pointing at it shows a card with every scan, typed as on MusicBrainz (Front ★, Back, Medium for a CD, Booklet), and a click opens the artwork viewer on them (Ctrl-click: the entry's page). The page is read on that first hover or click only, one request for that row. New setting "Art column: every scan of an entry on hover" (on by default, the card only).

brucespringsteen.it records: a new Photo column, the same way: a dashed tile until the record's page has been read, then its photo or "no photo" (many records have none; a photo the site hides as missing counts as none). Pointing at it shows the photo large; a click opens the viewer. New setting "Photo column: the record's photo on hover" (on by default, the card only).

On both sites, rows read before keep their picture: after the table appears, one read of the saved pages paints them, with no request to the site. Sorting by the Art/Photo column puts the rows with a picture first.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: jungleland.it and brucespringsteen.it now keep a page they read for half a year instead of 30 days (the preview and the new columns share it): these sites barely change. springsteenlyrics.com and Brucebase keep 30 days.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: The springsteenlyrics.com, jungleland.it and brucespringsteen.it image cards are built by one function (`_fiDpProvider()`) over the detail preview's page reader. `_sortCellText()` also reads the new hidden `.mb-fi-sort-key`: one more class in its one lookup; the MusicBrainz sort timing was compared before and after.

sections.label: 🚀 Feature
items: springsteenlyrics.com lists (collection, latest additions, bootlegs, CD and vinyl bootlegs): pointing at a cover shows a card with the cover and every artwork scan of that item, as the Cover Art column does on MusicBrainz (Space: every image, Shift: bigger tiles). The scans are read from the item's own page on that first hover, one request for that row only, kept 30 days and shared with the item preview; moving on before its turn asks nothing, and a bootleg the list marks as having no artwork is never asked. New setting "Cover column: every image of an item on hover" (on by default, inside the site's own switch).

A click on a cover opens the artwork viewer on that item's cover and scans: ← → through its images, Shift+← → through the rows the filter left, an "Item page" button. Ctrl-click (or a middle click) still opens the item page.

sections.label: 🔧 Refactor
items: Discogs' Image column card and viewer click now run on one shared path for every non-MusicBrainz site (`_fiCardHtml()`, `_fiClick()`, `_fiLoad()`, a provider per site), which the jungleland.it, brucespringsteen.it and Brucebase tables will use next. Its click listens on the window instead of the document. Unchanged on Discogs, except that a row with no other image now shows its thumbnail beside the note. Nothing changes on MusicBrainz, and nothing new runs while a table renders.
